entities.name: Danny García
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Danny Óscar Garcia is an American professional boxer. He has held multiple world championships in two weight classes, including the unified World Boxing Association (WBA), World Boxing Council (WBC), Ring magazine, and lineal light welterweight titles between 2012 and 2015, and the WBC welterweight title from 2016 to 2017.
